notablePrerequisites:
Obeka has power greater than or equal to five minus the number of filibuster counters on Azor's Elocutors.
Obeka does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Obeka.
Obeka triggers, causing you to get that many upkeep steps after this one.
Move to your first upkeep step.
Azor's Elocutors triggers, putting a filibuster counter on it and causing you to win the game if it has five or more filibuster counters on it.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining upkeep step as needed.
